name: no_brreg-mcp
description: Brønnøysundregistrene (sales): me, search, get_company. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Open data without credentials: verified with a one-item entity search (no account endpoint).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Norwegian register only: `query` is the `navn` name search; `country` and `industry` are ignored. `page` is zero-based on the API ('page: Integer, zero-based (default 0)') — the 1-based `page` argument is converted; (page+1)*size must stay <= 10 000. `address` is the first line of forretningsadresse.adresse; `size` is the employee count (antallAnsatte); `industry` is naeringskode1.beskrivelse (Norwegian). Live check 2026-09-24: Accept: application/json returns the current (v2) representation.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: `id` is the nine-digit organisasjonsnummer. 404 when unknown; '410 Gone' when 'Fjernet av juridiske årsaker' (removed for legal reasons) → platform_error.
